meta.name: The Last Scene
meta.description: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with a man, Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.
